events.title: The Lantern Bobbin Ferry
events.description: A bobbin boat rocks beneath hanging lanterns, its ragdoll ferryman winding loose thread in the amber hush.

choices.text: Pay the ferryman 12 gold for loose thread (+2 scraps)
Trade a thread bundle for parcel wages (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)
Walk along the bank (no cost or gain)

events.title: The Thimble Star Reading
events.description: A felt fortune-reader peers through a silver thimble at stitched constellations, their frame trailing pale starlint.

choices.text: Sell a spool to the reader (spend 1 scrap; gain 16 gold)
Collect thread caught in the frame (+1 scrap)

events.title: The Moonpatch Archway
events.description: Tiny cloth patches line a crescent arch; dangling price tags whisper against its candlelit seams.

choices.text: Purchase two spools (spend 15 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Sell two spools (spend 2 scraps; gain 27 gold)

events.title: The Blacklace Swap Table
events.description: Small button-eyed puppets barter ribbons over an ink-black lace tablecloth, their stitched smiles lit by candle stubs.

choices.text: Buy a small ribbon bundle (spend 8 gold; gain 1 scrap)
Sell your own bundle (spend 1 scrap; gain 14 gold)
Decline the trade (no cost or gain)

events.title: The Crooked Marionette
events.description: A wooden puppet dangles crookedly above a candle, offering a little coin purse for rethreading its frayed strings.

choices.text: Rethread the puppet's strings (spend 2 scraps; earn 30 gold)
Leave the puppet (no cost or gain)

events.title: The Dusk Post Bobbin
events.description: A patchwork postbox totters on a walking spindle, accepting thread-wrapped letters through a softly glowing slot.

choices.text: Pay postage and receive spare wrapping thread (spend 10 gold; gain 1 scrap)
Wrap letters for delivery wages (spend 1 scrap; earn 17 gold)
Pass the postbox (no cost or gain)
